# Hakush.in Character Data Scraper

> **Script**: `scripts/hakushin.py`
> **Output**: `src/data/charStats.ts`, `src/data/character_{lang}.json`

**ID Convention**: Files use **English IDs** (e.g. `varka`, `hu_tao`) generated by `hoyolab.generate_id()`, not the internal game-engine numeric IDs (e.g. `10000128`). The scraper builds a mapping from English ID → internal ID at startup by scanning the character list page.

## Overview

The scraper extracts character data from [gi.hakush.in](https://gi.hakush.in) using Playwright. The canonical URL redirects to a versioned subdomain (e.g. `gi20.hakush.in`), which is detected at runtime. The site is a Svelte application — all content renders client-side after `domcontentloaded`, and reactive UI controls (sliders) must be set via native property setters to trigger Svelte's reactivity.

---

## User Journey

A character page (e.g. `/character/10000128`) presents data in this order:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Character Header (name, element)   │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  #character-kit                     │
│  ├─ child[0]: Base Stats            │  ← Level slider (max=100), stat grid
│  ├─ child[1]: Skills section        │  ← "Skills SKILLS..." heading
│  │   ├─ S{id1}: Normal Attack       │     Each has name, desc, level slider, table
│  │   ├─ S{id2}: Elemental Skill     │
│  │   └─ S{id3}: Elemental Burst     │
│  ├─ child[2]: Passives section      │  ← "Passives PASSIVES..." heading
│  │   ├─ P{id1}: Passive 1           │     Each has name, desc (no table)
│  │   ├─ P{id2}: Passive 2           │
│  │   ├─ P{id3}: Passive 3           │
│  │   └─ P{id4}: Passive 4 (travel)  │
│  └─ child[3]: Constellations        │  ← "Constellations CONSTELLATIONS..." heading
│      ├─ T{id1}: C1                  │     Each has name, desc (no table)
│      ├─ T{id2}: C2                  │
│      ├─ ...                         │
│      └─ T{id6}: C6                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

A sidebar (`<sidebar>`) contains language options. Clicking a language label (e.g. "English", "中文(简体)") switches all text content reactively.

---

## Data Formats

### Stats: `src/data/charStats.ts`

Aggregated TypeScript export containing **all** character base stats. Non-i18n. Extracted once in English for consistent stat key labels.

```jsonc
// charStats["varka"]
{
  "Lv90": {
    "baseHp": "12613",     // Always present
    "baseAtk": "353",      // Always present
    "baseDef": "795",      // Always present
    "em": "0",             // Always present (Elemental Mastery)
    "cd": "38.4%"          // Ascension stat — varies per character
  },
  "Lv100": { /* same shape, higher values */ }
}
```

**Ascension stat key**: Uses `MainStat` literals from `src/data/types.ts`:

| Website Label          | JSON Key |
|------------------------|----------|
| CRIT Rate              | `cr`     |
| CRIT DMG               | `cd`     |
| Energy Recharge        | `er`     |
| Elemental Mastery      | `em`     |
| HP%                    | `hp%`    |
| ATK%                   | `atk%`   |
| DEF%                   | `def%`   |
| Healing Bonus          | `heal%`  |
| Pyro/Hydro/... DMG Bonus | `pyro%`, `hydro%`, ... |
| Physical DMG Bonus     | `phys%`  |

### Kit File: `character_{lang}.json`

One bundled file per language (currently `en`, `zh`), structured as `Record<englishId, KitData>`.

```jsonc
{
  "varka": {
  "skills": [
    {
      "name": "Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance",
      "descHtml": "Perform up to 5 rapid strikes...",
      "details": [                                     // [label, lv6, lv10, lv13]
        ["1-Hit DMG", "95.1%", "129.4%", "156.8%"],
        ["2-Hit DMG", "34.9%+64.8%", "47.4%+88.1%", "57.5%+106.7%"]
      ]
    }
    // Always 3 skills (Normal, Skill, Burst)
  ],
  "passives": [
    {
      "name": "Dawn Wind's March",
      "descHtml": "When the party has a <strong>...</strong>..."
    }
    // 3–5 passives (see Edge Cases below)
  ],
  "constellations": [
    {
      "name": "1. \"Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow\"",
      "descHtml": "When Varka switches to..."
    }
    // Always 6
  ],
  "glossary": [                               // null if no entries
    {
      "name": "Sturm und Drang",
      "descHtml": "Tap to unleash..."
    }
  ]
  }
}
```

**`descHtml` format**:
- Raw HTML with `<br>`, `<strong>`, `<span style="color: ...">` tags preserved.
- All `<a>` tags are **unwrapped** (text kept, tag removed).
- Consecutive whitespace collapsed to single spaces.
- Glossary `<a>` tags (with `data-tooltip` + `cursor-help` class) are extracted into the `glossary` map before unwrapping.
- Internal link `<a>` tags (e.g. `href="#S11282"`, class `underline`) are simply unwrapped.

**`glossary` value format**:
- Contains only the **description content** from the tooltip, not the title.
- The tooltip HTML has two divs: `<div class="...font-bold">Title</div>` and `<div class="...font-normal">Content</div>`. We extract only the inner HTML of the second div, stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.

---

## DOM Extraction Hints

> **These selectors may break if the site redesigns.** The data formats above are stable (game mechanics don't change). These hints help debug when selectors stop working.

### 1. Base URL Resolution

The canonical `gi.hakush.in` redirects to a versioned subdomain. We navigate to the canonical URL and capture `page.url` after load.

### 2. Character List (`/character`)

- **Selector**: `a[href*="/character/"]` filtered by regex `\/character\/\d+$`
- **Extraction**: `textContent` for name, regex capture group for ID

### 3. Base Stats (first child of `#character-kit`)

- **Container**: `document.querySelector('#character-kit').children[0]`
- **Level slider**: `#character-kit input[type="range"][max="100"]` — the `max=100` distinguishes it from skill-level sliders (max=15).
- **Stat rows**: `.grid.grid-cols-2` within the stats container. Each grid has two children: label (e.g. "Base HP") and value (e.g. "12613").
- **Slider interaction**: Must use the **native property setter** (`Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set`) followed by `input` + `change` events. Direct `.value =` assignment does NOT trigger Svelte's reactivity.

### 4. Kit Section Identification

Sections are **NOT identified by top-level IDs**. They are children of `#character-kit` identified by their **text content prefix**:

| Section         | Text prefix (EN)     | Text prefix (ZH) | Item ID pattern |
|-----------------|----------------------|-------------------|-----------------|
| Skills          | `"Skills"` or `"SKILLS"` | —            | `S\d+`          |
| Passives        | `"Passives"` or `"PASSIVES"` | `"固有天赋"` | `P\d+`          |
| Constellations  | `"Constellations"` or `"CONSTELLATIONS"` | `"命之座"` | `T\d+`   |

Within each section wrapper, individual items have `id` attributes matching these patterns (e.g. `id="S11281"`, `id="P1282101"`, `id="T1281"`).

### 5. Name Extraction (within each section item)

The name container has class `.text-lg`. Its structure:

```html
<div class="flex items-center pb-1 text-lg">
  Dawn Wind's March           <!-- TEXT_NODE: the name -->
  <div class="w-8 h-8 ...">  <!-- Icon image -->
    <img src="...">
  </div>
  <div class="flex flex-col ...">  <!-- "+" tooltip with In-game Values -->
    <a ...>+ <span class="...">In-game Value...</span></a>
  </div>
</div>
```

**Key insight**: The name is stored as **bare text nodes** before the first child element. Constellation names may span **multiple text nodes** (e.g. `"1"`, `". "`, `"\"Name\""`). We concatenate all text nodes before the first `Element` child.

### 6. Description Extraction

- **Selector**: `.text-sm.font-normal` within each section item
- **Content**: `innerHTML` (preserves `<br>`, `<strong>`, `<span>`)

### 7. Skill Detail Tables

- **Level slider**: `input[type="range"]` within each skill section (max=15)
- **Table container**: `.grid.grid-cols-1` within the skill section
- **Table rows**: `.grid.grid-cols-2` within the container — each row has two children (label, value)

### 8. Glossary Entries (hover-card links)

Found inside `descHtml`. These are `<a>` tags with **both**:
- `class` containing `cursor-help`
- `data-tooltip` attribute containing HTML-escaped tooltip content

The tooltip content (`data-tooltip`) is HTML-escaped and contains:
```html
<div class="flex pb-1 text-lg font-bold">Keyword Title</div>
<div class="text-sm font-normal">Description content...</div>
```

We unescape the HTML, then extract only the content of the `.font-normal` div.

### 9. Internal Links (skill cross-references)

Also inside `descHtml`. These are `<a>` tags with:
- `href` starting with `#` (e.g. `#S11282`, `#P1282201`)
- `class="underline"` (no `cursor-help`)

These are simply unwrapped (tag removed, text preserved).

### 10. Language Switching

- **Sidebar**: `document.querySelector('sidebar')` (custom element, not `<aside>`)
- **Language options**: Clickable `div` elements within the sidebar, matched by `textContent.trim()`.
- **⚠️ Key gotcha**: The sidebar only shows languages you can switch **to**. The currently active language does **not** appear as a clickable option. For example, if the page is in English, only "中文(简体)", "한국어", and "日本語" are shown — "English" is absent. The scraper handles this by interpreting a missing label as "already active".

---

## Scraping Architecture

The scraper uses a **two-pass** approach to avoid language-switching contamination:

| Pass | Language | Data Collected |
|------|----------|----------------|
| 1    | English (site default) | Base stats + EN kit |
| 2    | Chinese (explicit switch) | ZH kit only |

Language switching in headless mode is unreliable for stat labels (e.g. reading "基础生命值" instead of "Base HP" causes key mapping failures). By scraping stats only in Pass 1 (before any language switch), we guarantee English stat labels. Pass 2 switches to Chinese for kit text only.

Incremental mode (default) skips characters whose data files already exist. Use `--no-incremental` for a full re-scrape.

---

## Edge Cases

### Alternate Sprint (Ayaka, Mona)

Characters with an alternate sprint have **4 skill sections** in the DOM instead of 3. The scraper detects the alt-sprint by checking for **level-invariant values** (all detail rows identical at Lv 6/10/13). The alt-sprint entry is moved to **passives** (prepended, without `details`), keeping the `skills` array at exactly 3.

This means passives can range from 3 to 5: e.g. Mona has 3 regular passives + 1 travel passive + 1 alt-sprint = 5.

### Raiden Shogun Empty Passive

Raiden Shogun (`10000052`) has a placeholder passive with an empty name ("cannot cook" in Chinese). The scraper allows **exactly 1** empty-name passive for this character; any other character with an empty name will raise a parsing error.

### Blocked Characters

The scraper skips characters by **name** (`BLOCKLIST_NAMES`): "Traveler", "Manekin", "Manekina". These characters have multiple elemental variants that share a single page, which are not supported.

---

## Expected Counts (Sanity Checks)

| Data Point       | Expected Count | Notes |
|------------------|----------------|-------|
| Characters       | ≥ 50           | Grows with game updates |
| Skills           | 3              | Always 3 (alt-sprint is moved to passives) |
| Passives         | 3–5            | Base (3) + travel (0-1) + alt-sprint (0-1) |
| Constellations   | 6              | Always exactly 6 |
| Skill details    | 4 columns      | `[label, lv6, lv10, lv13]` |
| Base stat keys   | ≥ 4            | baseHp + baseAtk + baseDef + em + ascension stat |

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely Cause |
|---------|-------------|
| Timeout on navigation | Site changed subdomain; check redirect from `gi.hakush.in` |
| Empty stats / all zeros | Level slider selector changed; check `input[type="range"][max="100"]` |
| Missing section IDs | Section heading text changed; check `#character-kit` children text prefixes |
| Names contain "In-game Value" | `.text-lg` structure changed; check childNode ordering |
| Empty descriptions | `.text-sm.font-normal` selector no longer matches description div |
| Skill tables empty | `.grid.grid-cols-1 > .grid.grid-cols-2` nesting changed |
| Language switch fails (no sidebar) | `<sidebar>` element renamed or not rendered (timing/viewport) |
| Language switch fails (wrong data) | Language labels changed; or active language isn't excluded from options anymore |
| Glossary values include title | Tooltip HTML structure changed; check `.font-normal` div selector |
